sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेही परिक्रम्य हुताशनम् ।विवेश ज्वलनं दीप्तं निस्सङ्गेनान्तरात्मना ।। ६.११९.२८ ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu vaidehī parikramya hutāśanam ।viveśa jvalanaṁ dīptaṁ nissaṅgenāntarātmanā ।। 6.119.28 ।।

translations.english: "O gods! Supreme Aditya, wind god, god of the four quarters, and also by moon, and gods presiding during day, night, twilight and so also earth, know me as a woman of good character, let the fire god protect me that way."
